context_requirements: CRHR1 expression and functional Gs-coupled signaling
a CRF-family ligand autocrine/paracrine loop or exogenous CRF/UCN challenge
cell context in which CRHR1 activation drives measurable transcriptional output
falsifiers: reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
shared transcriptional signature across lines that is absent in CRHR1-knockout or CRHR1-knockdown cells
changes that are reversed by CRHR1 agonists or mimicked by CRHR1 agonists
